title: 第3章 武魂觉醒第4章 自愿败选
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
斗罗大陆，武魂殿，其招牌和殿堂开在两大帝国各个主城乃至乡镇中，如同一棵千年老树根深蒂固，牢牢的和这个武魂世界镶嵌在一起。
而且武魂殿还是个独立组织，并不受两大帝国管控，除了管理构架相当先进细致外，还有自己的私兵，说其为七大武魂宗门之外的第八宗甚至“第三帝国”也并不过分。
武魂殿除了为人们觉醒武魂，和给魂师们发放津贴外，本身也经常参与社区管理和布道，在民间威望极高。
以至于你或许不知道两大帝国的皇帝叫什么，但现任教皇千寻疾的名字却是所有人都耳熟能详的。
而且武魂殿不仅仅只是一个宗教和魂师管理机构，武魂殿还投资建设了许多孤儿院，用于收养两大帝国和其他王国的战争中的遗孤，或平民家的弃婴。
比如张三就是一个被武魂殿收养的弃婴，他在孤儿院里生活了六年，在第三年，张三觉醒了玄天功的记忆，后三年内张三努力修炼玄天功，很早就已经抵达瓶颈，而且无论如何都无法突破，张三这时本是不知缘由的。
而现在重生的张三则是明白自己是魂力已经到了十级，即没有觉醒武魂又缺个魂环，所以无法再进一步。
在一个光亮的小殿内，十余个身着灰布衣裳的孩童并排站着，仰头将或是焦虑或是好奇的目光投向台上那个身材高瘦戴眼镜的中年男人，张三也在其中，他静静地等待着这场自己已经知道结果的仪式。
“我是五十七级器魂师，罗翔，同时我也是你们的领路人。”
这中年男人低头看了一眼下面的孩童，神情既不冰冷也不热切，只是淡淡的说道：
“下面就是你们的武魂觉醒仪式。”
或许是觉得自己的开场还是太平淡了，罗翔一推眼镜，展开了自己的武魂，最佳配置黄、黄、紫、紫、黑五个魂环出现在其身后。
罗翔注意到下面的视线越发崇敬起来，斗罗大陆崇尚强者，魂王在这个世界已经有了立足的资本，但放在强者如云的武魂殿，他一个魂王也就是一个中级执事，并不算什么了不起的人物。
当然他也足够让这帮初出茅庐的小家伙们敬畏了。
“这是我的武魂‘天书法典’，你们接下来也会拥有这辈子专属于你们自己的武魂。”
罗翔手捧红皮法典，俯视着下面交头接耳的孩童们，厉声说道：
“现在你们全按照我的指示行动，你们都有接受过相关教育，具体流程我就不再细说了。”
“这期间不可喧哗，不可躁动，违者禁闭一天。”
说完惩罚，下面的孩童们就不敢再吵闹，然后罗翔才慢条斯理的说道：
“叫到名字的就应一声，再上前来。”

罗翔看着桌上的名册，说道：
“阿斯里。”
“在！”
一个英武的男孩应了声并站出了队伍。
罗翔指着讲台旁那个用六颗黑石摆好的法阵，说道：“上前来，到这里站着。”
“是！”
等英武的男孩在法阵中央站好，罗翔手中的红皮法典飘到空中，投射出六道红光到这六颗黑石中，随后黑石便冒出点点金光形成一个光罩将那男孩包裹并缓缓进入到男孩的身体中。
“伸出右手。”
男孩听话的伸出自己的右手，罗翔看着男孩手上冒出的长条形带着锋芒的虚影说道：
“你的武魂是剑，器武魂，主物攻，应该还算不错。”
然后罗翔继续说道：“现在集中精神，用意念收起武魂。”
那男孩眉头皱起废了好半天的工夫终于收起了自己的武魂。
中间罗翔就静静等着也不催促，等男孩收起武魂后，罗翔控制着讲桌上那颗蓝色水晶球让其飘到男孩面前，然后说道：
“来，测测魂力，将手放在这球上，试着把自己的力量投入其中。”
男孩依言照做，一会儿后水晶球有了反应，罗翔点头说道：
content_en:
Douluo Continent, Wuhun Palace, its signboards and halls are located in the main cities and even towns of the two empires, like a thousand-year-old tree with deep roots, firmly embedded in the Wuhun world.
Moreover, Wuhun Palace is an independent organization and is not controlled by the two major empires. In addition to its very advanced and meticulous management structure, it also has its own private soldiers. It is not an exaggeration to say that it is the eighth sect or even the "Third Empire" after the seven major Wuhun Sects.
In addition to awakening martial souls for people and distributing subsidies to soul masters, the Wuhun Palace itself often participates in community management and preaching, and has a high prestige among the people.
So much so that you may not know the names of the emperors of the two empires, but the name of the current Pope Qian Xunji is familiar to everyone.
Moreover, Wuhun Palace is not only a religious and soul master management institution, Wuhun Palace has also invested in the construction of many orphanages to adopt orphans from the wars between the two empires and other kingdoms, or abandoned babies from civilian families.
For example, Zhang San was an abandoned baby adopted by Wuhun Palace. He lived in the orphanage for six years. In the third year, Zhang San awakened the memory of Xuantian Kung. In the next three years, Zhang San worked hard to practice Xuantian Kung. He had reached the bottleneck very early and could not break through no matter what. Zhang San didn't know the reason at this time.
But the now reborn Zhang San understands that his soul power has reached the tenth level, that is, he has not awakened his martial soul and lacks a soul ring, so he cannot go further.
In a small bright hall, more than ten children in gray cloth stood side by side, raising their heads and casting anxious or curious eyes on the tall, thin, middle-aged man wearing glasses on the stage. Zhang San was among them. He was quietly waiting for this ceremony, which he already knew the outcome of.
"I am the fifty-seventh level weapon soul master, Luo Xiang, and I am also your leader."
The middle-aged man lowered his head and glanced at the child below. His expression was neither cold nor eager, and he just said lightly:
"The following is your martial soul awakening ceremony."
Perhaps because he felt that his opening was too bland, Luo Xiang pushed up his glasses and unfolded his martial soul. Five soul rings of the best configuration - yellow, yellow, purple, purple and black - appeared behind him.
Luo Xiang noticed that the eyes below were becoming more and more respectful. Douluo Continent respected the strong, and the Soul King already had the capital to gain a foothold in this world. However, in the Wuhun Palace where there were so many strong people, he, a Soul King, was just a mid-level deacon, and he was not a great figure.
Of course, he is enough to make these fledgling guys in awe.
"This is my martial spirit 'Heavenly Book Code'. You will also have your own martial spirit in this life."
Luo Xiang held the red leather code in his hand, looked down at the children whispering below, and said sternly:
"Now you all follow my instructions. You have all received relevant education. I won't go into details about the specific process."
"During this period, please do not make any noise or be restless. Violators will be detained for one day."
After saying the punishment, the children below did not dare to make any more noise, and then Luo Xiang said slowly:
"Whenever your name is called, answer it and come forward."
Luo Xiang looked at the roster on the table and said:
"Asri."
"Here!"
A brave boy responded and stood out of the team.
Luo Xiang pointed to the magic circle set up with six black stones next to the podium and said, "Come forward and stand here."
"Yes!"
When the heroic boy stood in the center of the magic circle, the red-skin codex in Luo Xiang's hand floated into the air and projected six red lights into the six black stones. Then little golden lights emerged from the black stones to form a light shield that enveloped the boy and slowly entered the boy's body.
"Extend your right hand."
The boy obediently stretched out his right hand. Luo Xiang looked at the long and sharp shadow emerging from the boy's hand and said:
"Your martial spirit is a sword, weapon spirit, and main object attack. It should be pretty good."
Then Luo Xiang continued:"Concentrate now and use your mind to put away your martial spirit."
The boy frowned and spent a long time finally putting away his martial spirit.
Luo Xiang waited quietly without urging him. After the boy put away his martial spirit, Luo Xiang controlled the blue crystal ball on the desk to float in front of the boy, and then said:
"Come, test your soul power, put your hand on this ball, and try to put your own strength into it."
The boy did as he was told. After a while, the crystal ball responded. Luo Xiang nodded and said:
